explanation: Erdős #228 (Littlewood): for all large n there is a degree-n ±1 polynomial with √n ≪ |P(z)| ≪ √n on |z| = 1, with uniform constants. The encoding (∃ c₁ c₂, eventually ∃ P with all coefficients ±1 and √n < c₁|P(z)|, |P(z)| < c₂√n) is correct. It was proved by Balister–Bollobás–Morris–Sahasrabudhe–Tiba. The statement is correct and solved.
